fair_comparison: Freeze exact joined row order, old held-out roles/denominator, baselines/ties and encoder/core source before evaluation. More rows change shuffle sequence and batches; that is data effect, not equal per-epoch compute.
Preserve zero-weight rows: removing them changes global normalization, shuffle/batch divisors and L2. New Root unit weights remain1.
Expose positive-position/shared negative-caption style bias; IDs/labels/ordinal never become features. Training-origin diagnostics stay separate from validation.
No warm-start, new seed, precision rewrite or optimizer tuning; failed historical models stay inactive.

memory.layout: Reuse owned CSR offsets/uint16indices/float64values +contiguous coefficients/gradients; one worker, no new locks/maps. Group-role slices preserve numeric IDs.
memory.precision: fp32 coefficients rounded before scoring; shadow weights/gradients/losses and CSR values are float64. Not an all-FP32-memory or native1.58-bit trainer.
memory.measure: Record actual row/nonzero/CSR-owned bytes, peakGoheap/allocations, whole-child OS RSS/time and stage clocks. Softheap/postRSS are not OS hard enforcement.

inference: Later repeatable text normalization+Features+Score+ranking cold/warm latency/allocations/RSS requires its own frozen workload and same weights; training wall time or model file size is not inference/GPU quality.
profiling: First actualFit may use bounded stage clocks. Optional pprof changes overhead/retained controls and needs a separate frozen workload/reservation; repeated corpus Fit still counts. Private profiles are not automatically public.
archive: Fresh archive-aware scoped512MiB retained census with model/trace/controller/readback reservations; old disk pass does not prove RAM/current admission. Named executables stay fully charged.
